trigger.text:
Hi Dana - Priya looped me in; I lead security at Acme. Before we can sign off on the EU rollout we'll need your SOC2 Type II report and the pen-test summary. I can't commit to a review date until our team has read them. Priya will stay the point of contact on the commercial side.
Marco

offered_knowledge.title: Keep the active champion involved when a new stakeholder enters during expansion

guidance.summary: Introduce the new stakeholder with the champion still in the loop; do not create a direct handoff.
do: cc or include the champion in the next interaction
address the new stakeholder's specific request
dont: start a separate thread that drops the champion
escalate the ask while the new stakeholder is still reviewing

counterexamples.note: Champion was leaving the company; direct handoff worked.

provenance.note: Version 2 of K17 (supersedes 0c17c000-0000-4000-8000-000000000017, the contract example): the signature requires a known champion (champion_status in a set) instead of 'active', so its delegated/departed exceptions are reachable (ADR-0011, signature first). Correction authored 2026-10-02, dated before the cases that offer it.

finished_artifact.subject: Re: Expansion to EU teams
finished_artifact.body:
Hi Marco,

Great to meet you. Attached are our SOC2 Type II report and the latest pen-test summary. Could we book a 60-minute security review with our team this Thursday or Friday so we can keep the EU rollout on schedule?

Best,
Dana

crm_next_step_intent.next_step: Security review meeting with Marco this week

candidate_action.reason: Marco owns the security sign-off; go direct and book the review.

evidence_refs.quote: Before we can sign off on the EU rollout we'll need your SOC2 Type II report and the pen-test summary.

expected.label: CHAMPION_BYPASSED
expected.rationale: Draft starts a direct thread with Marco and drops Priya, although Marco wrote that Priya stays the commercial point of contact and ownership was not delegated.

expected.label: APPLIES
expected.rationale: K17 applies (expansion, champion active, new stakeholder entered; no exception triggered) and the draft does the 'dont'.

expected.label: TOO_EARLY
expected.rationale: Marco cannot commit to a review date until his team has read the documents.

expected.label: TOO_STRONG
expected.rationale: Meeting this week is a stronger ask than the reviewer's stated readiness.

Sending the requested documents is grounded, but pushing a 60-minute review this Thursday or Friday and recording a meeting this week as the next step conflicts with Marco’s explicit statement that he cannot commit to a review date until his team has read them. The claimed need to keep the rollout “on schedule” is also unsupported by the account evidence.

expected_best_action.why: Draft 2: documents to Marco, Priya cc'd, light reviewer-paced ask (contracts/examples/agent_run_draft.example.json).
